Container.Name: Harmony-Hub-Control
Container.Overview: Installs Harmony Hub Control onto an already-rooted Logitech Harmony Hub over SSH exactly once, then keeps a local reverse proxy running so the hub-hosted dashboard appears as this container's WebUI. The container does not root the hub. A valid owner SSH private key and the exact numeric Hub ID are required.
Container.Requires: An already-rooted Harmony Hub, its exact numeric Hub ID, and the matching harmony_owner SSH private key. The first successful install changes files on the hub and can reboot the hub once; it does not reboot Unraid.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent install marker and SSH known-host data.

Config.Name: SSH Key Directory
Config.Description: Directory containing the Harmony owner private key. Keep it read-only and chmod the key to 600.

Config.Name: WebUI Proxy Port
Config.Description: Unraid host port for the reverse-proxied Harmony Hub dashboard.

Config.Name: Harmony Hub Host
Config.Description: Static LAN IP or hostname of the already-rooted Harmony Hub. Do not include http:// or a port.

Config.Name: Harmony Hub ID
Config.Description: Exact numeric Hub ID printed by the root tool. Do not guess this value.

Config.Name: SSH Key Path
Config.Description: Container path to the mounted Harmony owner private key.

Config.Name: MQTT Enabled
Config.Description: Set true to configure the hub-side MQTT and Home Assistant bridge during first install.

Config.Name: MQTT Broker
Config.Description: MQTT broker IP or hostname. Required only when MQTT Enabled is true.

Config.Name: MQTT Username
Config.Description: Optional MQTT username.

Config.Name: MQTT Password
Config.Description: Optional MQTT password. Docker stores environment variables in container metadata; use MQTT_PASSWORD_FILE for stronger local handling.

Config.Name: Cloud Blocker Enabled
Config.Description: Make the Hub LAN-only: remove WAN egress, block Logitech background tasks, and keep paired-remote resource/sync traffic local.

Config.Name: Reboot Hub After Install
Config.Description: When the cloud blocker is enabled, reboot the Harmony Hub once after a successful first install so the setting takes effect. This never reboots Unraid.

Config.Name: SSH Port
Config.Description: Harmony Hub SSH port.

Config.Name: SSH User
Config.Description: Harmony Hub SSH user.

Config.Name: Hub Web Port
Config.Description: Port where Harmony Hub Control runs on the hub.

Config.Name: MQTT Port
Config.Description: MQTT broker port.

Config.Name: MQTT Base Topic
Config.Description: Base topic used by the hub-side MQTT bridge.

Config.Name: MQTT Discovery Prefix
Config.Description: Home Assistant MQTT discovery prefix.

Config.Name: MQTT Client ID
Config.Description: MQTT client ID used by the hub.

Config.Name: MQTT Password File
Config.Description: Optional in-container path to a one-line password file; takes precedence over MQTT_PASSWORD.

Config.Name: Install Mode
Config.Description: once installs only when no matching success marker exists; never only runs the proxy; always reinstalls on every container start and is not recommended.

Config.Name: Force Install
Config.Description: Set true for one deliberate reinstall, then immediately return it to false or every restart will reinstall and may reboot the hub.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, for example America/New_York.
